It's multiplicative, NOT additive...

The math for 66% (infused terror), 33% (protection), 33% (reaper shroud) would be (using counter probability): 

0.67*(0.67*0.34) = 0.1526 = 15.26% remaining damage 

-> 1-0.1526 = 0.8474 -> 84.74% total damage reduction.
